Name: MAP_PIECE_TEX_PARAM_ST_DLC02
Description: Save location name and multiplayer area per part of the Realm of Shadow (m61; the overworld uses MapPieceTexParam). The game reads the map info texture of the 1024 m tile the player is on (256 × 256 pixels, 4 m per pixel, north up): the red channel of the pixel under the player is the row ID (0–255). Each row either sets one value for the whole area, or splits it into a low and a high part by the player's height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes). No row for that value: both values count as -1. The game ignores this param unless its data version is 2 or higher (retail: 2).

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Red
Fields.Description: Red of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Green
Fields.Description: Green of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Blue
Fields.Description: Blue of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Save Map Name ID
Fields.Description: PlaceName text recorded as the player's current location name while in this area (kept separately from the on-screen place-name banner). Used only while Separate by High and Low Altitudes is off. -1: uses the MapNameTexParam_m61 place name with its sign removed. A location name set by the game (event or map override) takes precedence. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Area ID
Fields.Description: PlayRegionParam row that becomes the current play region (multiplayer area) while the player is in this area. Used only while Separate by High and Low Altitudes is off. -1: the play region is derived from the map ID instead. A play region set by the game (event or map override) takes precedence.

Fields.Name: Separate by High and Low Altitudes
Fields.Description: On (non-zero): the row uses its Low Altitude and High Altitude fields, picked by the player's height against High / Low Altitude Boundary Height, and its plain Save Map Name ID and Multiplayer Area ID are ignored. Off: the plain fields apply and the Low/High fields are ignored.

Fields.Name: High / Low Altitude Boundary Height
Fields.Description: Height in whole metres that splits the area when Separate by High and Low Altitudes is on. The player's height is their vertical position in the Realm of Shadow map's own coordinates: above this value the High Altitude fields apply, at or below it the Low Altitude fields. Can be negative (retail -200 to 530 on split rows).

Fields.Name: Low Altitude: Save Map Name ID
Fields.Description: Save Map Name ID used while the player is at or below the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). -1: uses the place name with its sign removed. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: High Altitude: Save Map Name ID
Fields.Description: Save Map Name ID used while the player is above the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). -1: uses the place name with its sign removed. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Low Altitude: Multiplayer Area ID
Fields.Description: PlayRegionParam row used as the play region while the player is at or below the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). -1: the play region is derived from the map ID instead.

Fields.Name: High Altitude: Multiplayer Area ID
Fields.Description: PlayRegionParam row used as the play region while the player is above the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). -1: the play region is derived from the map ID instead.
